entries.title: Monochrome grey outfit color palette
entries.pieces: Palette: Charcoal #3A3632 · Slate #6E6E6E · Stone #A59E92 · Dove #D9D6D1 · White #FAF7F0

A white tee or sneaker keeps it fresh.
